notes.title: All My Games are now Available on Itch.io!
notes.content:
Squirm, Loop-Loop DX AND Pocket Squirm are now available in a bundle called "The Squirm-Squirm DX Combo Meal" on  Itch.io for a pay what you want price!

Take a look [url=https://alpentater.itch.io/squirm-squirmdx]here[/url]!

I haven't made anything in 4 years. 
I have a story to tell, but it's kind of hard to do that when all the games I've made were sloppily written by a late-teen version of my self.

Therefore, I've decided to wrap up all the old stuff into one nice package.
Seems like like a fitting way to be finished with the old and on to the new.
A fresh start, if you will.

Much more is coming soon...

Thank you.
- Alex :)

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Patchnotes!
notes.content:
Remember the patch I did yesterday?
Well... by fixing the white zone it broke Legacy Mode!
Yay!

That's ok, because this patch un-breaks it!
Woooo!

- Alex :D

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 patchnotes!
notes.content:
- Fixed the white zone lagging some poor folks computers to death.
If for whatever reason the white zone still lags, try turning off "Light Effects" in the pause menu.
If you turn off "Light Effects" and it STILL lags... yell at me!

- Fixed the blue phase of the final boss being impossible for people with high monitor refresh rates.

Thanks for playing and enjoying Loop-Loop DX!
- Alex :D
